exact_native_clauses.name: s3306_a_1_is_wages
exact_native_clauses.text:
s3306_a_1_is_wages(Person, Year, Remuneration, Wages) :-
    s3306_b(Wages,Remuneration,Service,Person,_,_,_,_),
	start_(Remuneration,Time),
    last_day_year(Year,Last_day_year),
    is_before(Time,Last_day_year),
    first_day_year(Year,First_day_year),
    is_before(First_day_year,Time),
    \+ purpose_(Service, "agricultural labor"),
	\+ purpose_(Service, "domestic service").

exact_native_clauses.name: s3306_a_1_A
exact_native_clauses.text:
s3306_a_1_A(Employee,Caly,Wages) :-
	findall(
		Amount,
		(
			s3306_a_1_is_wages(Employee, Caly, Remuneration, Amount);
			(
				Pyear is Caly-1,
				s3306_a_1_is_wages(Employee, Pyear, Remuneration, Amount)
			)
		),
		Wages_list
	),
	sum_list(Wages_list,Wages),
	Wages>=1500.

exact_native_clauses.name: s3306_a_1_is_day_of_employment
exact_native_clauses.text:
s3306_a_1_is_day_of_employment(Person, Employee, Day) :-
	s3306_c(Service,Person,Employee,Day,_),
    \+ purpose_(Service,"agricultural labor"),
    \+ purpose_(Service,"domestic service"),
    \+ type_(Service,"agricultural labor"),
    \+ type_(Service,"domestic service").

exact_native_clauses.name: s3306_a_3_is_wages
exact_native_clauses.text:
s3306_a_3_is_wages(Person, Year, Remuneration, Service, Wages) :-
    s3306_b(Wages,Remuneration,Service,Person,_,_,_,_),
    start_(Remuneration,Time),
    last_day_year(Year,Last_day_year),
    is_before(Time,Last_day_year),
    first_day_year(Year,First_day_year),
    is_before(First_day_year,Time),
	(
		(
			\+ means_(Remuneration,_)
		);
		(
			means_(Remuneration,"cash")
		)
	),
	purpose_(Service, "domestic service").

exact_native_clauses.name: s3306_a_3
exact_native_clauses.text:
s3306_a_3(Employer,Service,Wages,Caly) :-
	findall(
		(Amount,Service_),
        (
			s3306_a_3_is_wages(Employer, Caly, Epay, Service_, Amount);
			(
				Pyear is Caly-1,
				s3306_a_3_is_wages(Employer, Pyear, Epay, Service_, Amount)
			)
		),
		Amount_service
	),
    findall(
        Amount,
        member((Amount,_),Amount_service),
        Wages_list
    ),
    findall(
        Service_,
        member((_,Service_),Amount_service),
        Service
    ),
	sum_list(Wages_list,Wages),
	Wages>=1000.

purpose_(domestic_service,"domestic service").
purpose_(other_service,"work").
start_(domestic_payment,payyear(Y)) :- inputs(Y,_,_,_,_).
start_(other_payment,payyear(Y)) :- inputs(_,Y,_,_,_).
first_day_year(Y,lower(Y)).
last_day_year(Y,upper(Y)).
is_before(payyear(Y),upper(Z)) :- Y=<Z.
is_before(lower(Z),payyear(Y)) :- Z=<Y.
means_(domestic_payment,"cash") :- inputs(_,_,_,_,1).
means_(domestic_payment,"hay") :- inputs(_,_,_,_,2).
s3306_c(domestic_service,"Alice","Bob",possible_workday,2018).
s3306_c(other_service,"Bob","Alice",possible_workday,2018).
main :-
 forall((member(DY,[2016,2017,2018,2019]),member(OY,[2016,2017,2018,2019]),
         member(DA,[0,1]),member(OA,[0,1]),member(Cash,[0,1,2])),
   (retractall(inputs(_,_,_,_,_)),assertz(inputs(DY,OY,DA,OA,Cash)),
    (s3306_a_1_A("Alice",2018,_)->AW=1;AW=0),
    (s3306_a_1_A("Bob",2018,_)->BW=1;BW=0),
    findall(D,s3306_a_1_is_day_of_employment("Alice",_,D),Days),length(Days,ND),
    (s3306_a_3("Alice",_,DW,2018)->Domestic=1;DW=0,Domestic=0),
